x: Our visitors, as last year, again brought a strong team along containing several University athletes, and Tommy Hampson, the International runner, and a member of our Club.
Our opening meeting at Battersea Park Track on May 2nd was blessed with fine weather and a huge crowd enjoyed the fine racing between the London Athletic Club and our own Club.
The London Athletic Club provided the opposition in the match events, while we also staged the Southern Amateur Athletic League 3 Miles Team Race.
